title: Kordylewski clouds as possible conscious plasma entities

tellings.quote: There are two of them as I recall at the L5 point. They are approximately nine times as large as the Earth itself.

plain: The Kordylewski clouds are huge, faint clouds in space said to sit at L5, a spot along the Moon's orbit where the pull of Earth and Moon balance, and one idea holds that they might be conscious beings made of plasma, the electrically charged gas found in stars. Jeffrey Mishlove, a psychologist with a PhD who studies psychic phenomena, brings this up with Michels from the writer Robert Temple's book A New Science of Heaven. He recalls that "there are two of them" and that they are "approximately nine times as large as the Earth." If true, there might be living minds of a kind no one expects right next to our planet.
